verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י וְלֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ קָדְשִׁ֑י שֵׁ֣ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·yin·nā·zə·rū miq·qā·ḏə·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer hêm maq·di·šîm lî wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites . . . - have consecrated to Me so that they do not profane - My holy name I am the LORD

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ׀ אֲשֶׁר־ מִכָּל־ זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־ וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו יִקְרַ֣ב הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הַהִ֛וא הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer- mik·kāl zar·‘ă·ḵem ’el- wə·ṭum·’ā·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw yiq·raḇ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl yaq·dî·šū Yah·weh ha·hi·w han·ne·p̄eš wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh mil·lə·p̄ā·nay ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Tell them [that] for the generations to come if any - - of [their] descendants . . . in a state of uncleanness . . . approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites . . . consecrate to the LORD that person must be cut off from My presence I am the LORD

verses.original: מִזֶּ֣רַע אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֙וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב יֹאכַ֔ל לֹ֣א בַּקֳּדָשִׁים֙ עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּכָל־ טְמֵא־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: miz·ze·ra‘ ’îš ’îš ’a·hă·rōn wə·hū ṣā·rū·a‘ ’ōw zāḇ yō·ḵal lō baq·qo·ḏā·šîm ‘aḏ ’ă·šer yiṭ·hār wə·han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵāl ṭə·mê- ne·p̄eš ’ōw ’îš ’ă·šer- tê·ṣê mim·men·nū šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘
verses.literal: If a descendant . . . . . . of Aaron . . . has a skin disease or a discharge he may not eat . . . the sacred offerings until - he is clean Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen

verses.original: אוֹ־ אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּכָל־ שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ ל֑וֹ א֤וֹ בְאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ ל֔וֹ לְכֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ’îš ’ă·šer yig·ga‘ bə·ḵāl še·reṣ ’ă·šer yiṭ·mā- lōw ’ōw ḇə·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer yiṭ·mā- lōw lə·ḵōl ṭum·’ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or whoever - touches a crawling creature - - or a person that makes him unclean whatever the uncleanness may be

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע־ בּ֔וֹ וְטָמְאָ֖ה עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְלֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם־ רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer tig·ga‘- bōw wə·ṭā·mə·’āh ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·lō yō·ḵal min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kî ’im- rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless . . . he has bathed himself with water

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּבָ֥א וְטָהֵ֑ר וְאַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ לַחְמ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš ū·ḇā wə·ṭā·hêr wə·’a·ḥar yō·ḵal min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kî hū laḥ·mōw
verses.literal: When the sun has set he will become clean and then he may eat from the sacred offerings for they are his food

verses.original: לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל נְבֵלָ֧ה וּטְרֵפָ֛ה לְטָמְאָה־ בָ֑הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō yō·ḵal nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh lə·ṭā·mə·’āh- ḇāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals which would make him unclean I am the LORD

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּמֵ֥תוּ ב֖וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî wə·lō- yiś·’ū ‘ā·lāw ḥêṭ ū·mê·ṯū ḇōw kî yə·ḥal·lə·lu·hū ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: [The priests] must keep - My charge lest they bear - the guilt and die because they profane it I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: לֹא־ וְכָל־ זָ֖ר יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ לֹא־ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְשָׂכִ֖יר יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- wə·ḵāl zār yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš lō- tō·wō·šaḇ kō·hên wə·śā·ḵîr yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: No one outside [a priest’s family] may eat the sacred offering nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat [it]

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְכֹהֵ֗ן יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔וֹ הֵ֖ם וִילִ֣יד בֵּית֔וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑וֹ יֹאכְל֥וּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·ḵō·hên yiq·neh ne·p̄eš qin·yan kas·pōw hêm wî·lîḏ bê·ṯōw hū yō·ḵal bōw yō·ḵə·lū ḇə·laḥ·mōw
verses.literal: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money or if [a slave] is born in his household that [slave] may eat - his food

verses.original: כִּ֥י כֹּהֵ֔ן וּבַת־ תִהְיֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בִּתְרוּמַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: kî kō·hên ū·ḇaṯ- ṯih·yeh lə·’îš zār hî lō ṯō·ḵêl haq·qo·ḏā·šîm biṯ·rū·maṯ
verses.literal: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other [than a priest] she is not to eat of the sacred contributions

verses.original: כִּ֨י כֹּהֵן֩ וּבַת־ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒ וְזֶרַע֮ תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְשָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ בֵּ֤ית תֹּאכֵ֑ל אָבִ֖יהָ מִלֶּ֥חֶם כִּנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וְכָל־ לֹא־ זָ֖ר יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî kō·hên ū·ḇaṯ- ’ên lāh wə·ze·ra‘ ṯih·yeh ’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh wə·šā·ḇāh ’el- ’ā·ḇî·hā bêṯ tō·ḵêl ’ā·ḇî·hā mil·le·ḥem kin·‘ū·re·hā wə·ḵāl lō- zār yō·ḵal bōw
verses.literal: But if a priest’s daughter with no - children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house she may share her father’s food as in her youth But no . . . outsider may share it

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִ֕ישׁ יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְיָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’îš yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš biš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·šî·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·nā·ṯan haq·qō·ḏeš lak·kō·hên ’eṯ-
verses.literal: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest -

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יָרִ֖ימוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yā·rî·mū Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priests must not profane - the sacred offerings [that] the Israelites . . . - - present to the LORD

verses.original: בְּאָכְלָ֖ם אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְהִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·ḵə·lām ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê·hem wə·hiś·śî·’ū ’ō·w·ṯām ‘ă·wōn ’aš·māh kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: by allowing the people to eat - the sacred offerings and thus to bear - the punishment for guilt For I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ וּמִן־ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לְעֹלָֽה׃ לַיהוָ֖ה נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכָל־ נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·’el kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’îš ū·min- mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hag·gêr bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yaq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw lə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū lə·‘ō·lāh Yah·weh niḏ·rê·hem ū·lə·ḵāl- niḏ·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Speak to Aaron . . . and his sons . . . and all the Israelites . . . and tell them Any man . . . of the house of Israel or any foreign resident - who presents a gift . . . - for a burnt offering to the LORD whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering

verses.original: תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּבָּקָ֕ר בַּכְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃ לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם
verses.transliteration: tā·mîm zā·ḵār bab·bā·qār bak·kə·śā·ḇîm ū·ḇā·‘iz·zîm lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem
verses.literal: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle sheep or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם כִּי־ לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֥ה לְרָצ֖וֹן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaq·rî·ḇū kōl ’ă·šer- bōw mūm kî- lō yih·yeh lə·rā·ṣō·wn lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not present anything with a defect because it will not be accepted on your behalf

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִ֗ישׁ יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־ שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ תָּמִ֤ים כָּל־ לֹ֥א מ֖וּם לְרָצ֔וֹן יִהְיֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’îš yaq·rîḇ ze·ḇaḥ- šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh bab·bā·qār ’ōw ḇaṣ·ṣōn lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw lin·ḏā·ḇāh yih·yeh tā·mîm kāl- lō mūm lə·rā·ṣō·wn yih·yeh- bōw
verses.literal: When a man presents vvv a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering it must be without blemish - - [or] defect to be acceptable

verses.original: לֹא־ תַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה אֵ֖לֶּה עַוֶּרֶת֩ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־ חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־ א֨וֹ יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־ תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ’êl·leh ‘aw·we·reṯ šā·ḇūr ’ōw- ḥā·rūṣ ’ōw- ’ōw yab·be·leṯ ’ōw ḡā·rāḇ ’ōw yal·le·p̄eṯ lō- ṯit·tə·nū mê·hem ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are not to present to the LORD [any animal] that is blind injured or maimed . . . or anything with a running sore . . . a festering rash . . . or a scab you must not put any of these on the altar as a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ נְדָבָה֙ וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯōw nə·ḏā·ḇāh wə·šō·wr wā·śeh śā·rū·a‘ wə·qā·lūṭ lō yê·rā·ṣeh ū·lə·nê·ḏer
verses.literal: You may present - as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ū·mā·‘ūḵ wə·ḵā·ṯūṯ wə·nā·ṯūq wə·ḵā·rūṯ lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ū·ḇə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem
verses.literal: You are not to present to the LORD [an animal whose testicles are] bruised crushed torn or cut you are not to sacrifice them in your land

verses.original: וּמִיַּ֣ד לֹ֥א בֶּן־ נֵכָ֗ר תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־ לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃פ כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: ū·mî·yaḏ lō ben- nê·ḵār ṯaq·rî·ḇū ’eṯ- le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem mik·kāl ’êl·leh lō yê·rā·ṣū lā·ḵem kî mā·šə·ḥā·ṯām bā·hem mūm bām
verses.literal: - Neither you nor a foreigner . . . shall present - food to your God from any such [animal] They will not be accepted on your behalf because they are deformed and flawed

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י שׁ֣וֹר כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־ אוֹ־ עֵז֙ יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וּמִיּ֤וֹם וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לְקָרְבַּ֥ן לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî šō·wr ḵe·śeḇ ’ōw- ’ōw- ‘êz yiw·wā·lêḏ wə·hā·yāh ta·ḥaṯ ’im·mōw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm haš·šə·mî·nî ū·mî·yō·wm wā·hā·lə·’āh yê·rā·ṣeh ’iš·šeh lə·qā·rə·ban Yah·weh
verses.literal: When an ox a sheep . . . or a goat is born it must remain with its mother for seven days From the eighth day on it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the LORD

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־ שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־ אֶחָֽד׃ בְּי֥וֹם בְּנ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯiš·ḥă·ṭū wə·šō·wr ’ōw- śeh ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- ’e·ḥāḏ bə·yō·wm bə·nōw
verses.literal: But you must not slaughter an ox or a sheep - - on the same day as its young

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תִזְבְּח֥וּ תּוֹדָ֖ה זֶֽבַח־ לַיהוָ֑ה תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃ לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯiz·bə·ḥū tō·w·ḏāh ze·ḇaḥ- Yah·weh tiz·bā·ḥū lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem
verses.literal: When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD offer it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf

verses.original: יֵאָכֵ֔ל הַהוּא֙ בַּיּ֤וֹם לֹֽא־ תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־ בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yê·’ā·ḵêl ha·hū bay·yō·wm lō- ṯō·w·ṯî·rū mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: It must be eaten that same day Do not leave any of it until morning I am the LORD

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem miṣ·wō·ṯay wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are to keep My commandments and practice them I am the LORD

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־ קָדְשִׁ֔י שֵׁ֣ם וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm wə·niq·daš·tî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not profane - My holy name I must be acknowledged as holy among the Israelites . . . I am the LORD who sanctifies you

verses.original: הַמּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ham·mō·w·ṣî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yō·wṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: who brought you out - of the land of Egypt to be your God I am the LORD
